title: PPQ EAB Known Infested Counties Feature Layer View
description: This polygon layer contains the known infested counties where Emerald Ash Borer has been detected as well as the year the detection was reported.
licenseInfo: These data, and all the information contained therein, have been collected by the U.S. Department of Agriculture's Marketing and Regulatory Programs Business Services’ (MRPBS) Animal and Plant Health Inspection Service (APHIS) and/or Agriculture Marketing Service (AMS), or by its cooperators on APHIS’ and/or AMS’ behalf, for restricted government purposes only and is the sole property of MRPBS, APHIS or AMS. Data may be disseminated on a need-to-know basis only and must be used for their intended government purpose(s).  All information contained within these data are subject to required Federal safeguards and shall only be shared and/or used consistent with the Trade Secrets Act [18 U.S.C. 1905], the Privacy Act of 1974, as amended [5 U.S.C. 552a], the Freedom of Information Act [5 U.S.C. 552], the confidentiality provisions of the Food Security Act of 1985 [7 U.S.C. 2276], Section 1619 of the Food, Conservation, and Energy Act of 2008 [7 U.S.C. 8791], and other applicable Federal laws and implementing regulations, as well as with the confidentiality or non-disclosure provisions of any other agreement entered into between MRPBS, APHIS, AMS and a cooperator.
decision: Do not implement or acquire a new national production run from this item until its restrictive metadata is resolved or a separately qualified source is used. Public access is not evidence of unrestricted reuse.
currentYieldQualification: No new county data acquired or integrated. Prior +75 lead is not a validated production yield.
existingEvidence: Existing legacy APHIS EAB evidence remains preserved; this review does not retract or relicense it.
